capabilities: Draw pen, highlighter and eraser strokes over rendered Markdown notes
Write and circle directly on PDF pages with page-aware rendering
Add highlight, underline, strikethrough and note annotations to selected PDF text
Store strokes and annotations as separate .ink.json files outside the notes
Adjust stroke width, colors and toolbar position in a draggable floating toolbar
extras: Freemium: a separate commercial Pro build adds standalone handwritten notes, an annotation center, and licensed activation; the in-app interface is currently labelled only in Simplified Chinese; uninstalling the plugin or deleting the annotations folder removes all ink.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite or mark up notes and PDFs with a stylus, and existing editing tools would rewrite the source file.
summary: Stylus-first handwritten annotation tool for Markdown notes and PDFs that overlays ink, highlights and text annotations without modifying source files.
